methodology.eligibilitySql: CoverType='שטח פתוח' AND Dunam >= 20 AND Dunam <= 250 AND GrowthName IS NOT NULL AND AnafName <> 'לא מעובד'
methodology.selection: Top 100 after transparent screening in each of five agricultural districts, paging through the eligible universe, capped at five per authority/locality and excluding parcel centroids inside current AGRO planning polygons.
methodology.priorityBands: Within each district shortlist: top 25% high, middle 50% medium, final 25% early. Bands rank evidence and screening readiness, not technical suitability.
